title: 第六章 寒潭冰魄
content_zh:
当清晨第一缕阳光,照在虎芸的脸上,她便缓缓睁开眼睛。使劲揉揉还有些睡意朦胧的眼,虎芸才看见。江尘已经烤好了妖兽肉,并且将一大块都递到了自己面前。

    “谢谢”。

    虎芸接过烤肉,或许是跟江尘熟了,或许是忘记了。全然不似昨晚那般细嚼慢咽,而是像江尘一般大口大口吃了起来。

    江尘见状,脸上洋溢着笑,说道:“早就该这样了,吃烤肉自然是大口大口的吃,才最有滋味。”

    闻言,虎芸也是笑了笑,居然开玩笑一般的说道:“大概我是被你这个家伙给带沟里去了。算了,本小姐就不跟你计较了,你把那个玉芝琼浆拿出来,让我多喝几口就行了,否则的话别怪本小姐欺负你。”

    江尘则是哈哈一笑,故作正经道:“大小姐,你就可怜可怜小的,存钱买点喝的不容易,饶了我吧。”

    虎芸笑得差点一口喷了出来,笑了笑才说道:“江尘,不跟你闹了。我想跟着你一起猎杀妖兽,不知道你同不同意。”

    “当然没问题,老家伙说孤男寡女独处一处,是男人就该对女人负责。你放心,我是不会丢下你不管的。”江尘没心没肺的说道。却没有看到,当他说道要负责的时候,虎芸那张小脸上,不知何时出现了一抹红晕。

    “这···这可是你自己说的,你可要···”虎芸低着头,声音却越来越小。

    江尘则是咬下一大口肉,“嗯,我说到做到,你以后就跟我混,我保证你安全通过这次的测试。”

    待到两人吃完,这才结伴向前而去。

    时光如梭,转眼便是三天。

    三天的时间里面,江尘跟虎芸一起,配合的很是默契。江尘也发现自己是小瞧了虎芸的实力。原来只有十岁的虎芸,实力却也有一星星师境。不过想想江尘也就释怀了。

    而三天里,虎芸对江尘简直可以用崇拜来形容了。她没有想到,江尘的实力居然不比她弱,甚至可能更强。特别是江尘施展出的一指断乾坤星技,让虎芸都有些忌惮。奈何她从小学习家族霸王枪星技,故而只对枪法格外感兴趣,否则她定然会缠着江尘教她学习这个星技。

    这三天,他们一共猎杀了一千九百头二星妖兽,其中大部分都是低阶的,中阶有十一头,高阶的只有三头。折合成功勋点一共是五万七千两百九十点,其中二星低阶妖兽可换三十点,中阶五十点,高阶一百点。
content_en:
When the first ray of sunlight in the morning shone on Huyun's face, she slowly opened her eyes. After rubbing her still sleepy eyes vigorously, Hu Yun finally saw them. Jiang Chen had already roasted the monster meat and handed a large piece of it in front of him.

    "Thanks".

    Hu Yun took the barbecue, maybe because she was familiar with Jiang Chen, or maybe she forgot about it. It wasn't like he chewed slowly as he did last night, but he ate it like Jiang Chen.

    When Jiang Chen saw this, his face was filled with a smile, and he said: "It should have been like this a long time ago. When eating barbecue, it is natural to eat it in big mouthfuls, which is the most delicious."

    Hearing this, Hu Yun also smiled and actually said jokingly: "Maybe I was led into a ditch by you. Forget it, I won't argue with you. Just take out the Yuzhi wine and let me drink a few more sips. Otherwise, don't blame me for bullying you."

    Jiang Chen laughed and pretended to be serious: "Miss, you have to pity the poor kid. It's not easy to save money to buy something to drink. Please spare me."

    Hu Yun laughed so hard that she almost spit out her mouth. She smiled and said, "Jiang Chen, I won't make trouble with you anymore. I want to hunt monsters with you, but I don't know if you agree or not."

    "Of course it's no problem. The old guy said that when a man and a woman are alone, a man should be responsible for the woman. Don't worry, I won't leave you alone." Jiang Chen said carelessly. But they didn't see that when he said he would take responsibility, a blush appeared on Huyun's little face.

    "This... you said this yourself, do you want..." Hu Yun lowered her head, but her voice became smaller and smaller.

    Jiang Chen took a big bite of the meat and said, "Well, I will keep my word. You can hang out with me from now on. I will ensure that you pass this test safely."

    After the two of them finished eating, they went forward together.

    Time flies, and three days pass in the blink of an eye.

    During the three days, Jiang Chen and Hu Yun worked together very well. Jiang Chen also realized that he had underestimated Hu Yun's strength. It turns out that Hu Yun is only ten years old, but her strength is at the level of a star master. But thinking about it, Jiang Chen felt relieved.

    In the past three days, Hu Yun could only describe her admiration for Jiang Chen. She did not expect that Jiang Chen's strength was not weaker than hers, and might even be stronger. Especially the one-finger-severing star technique displayed by Jiang Chen made Hu Yun a little afraid. However, she had been learning the family overlord's spear star skill since she was a child, so she was only particularly interested in the marksmanship, otherwise she would have pestered Jiang Chen to teach her this star skill.

    In the past three days, they had hunted a total of 1,900 two-star monsters, most of which were low-level, with eleven mid-level beasts and only three high-level beasts. The converted merit points are a total of fifty-seven thousand two hundred and ninety points, of which two-star low-level monsters can be exchanged for thirty points, mid-level ones for fifty points, and high-level ones for one hundred points.
